MERGE: needs rebase before review. #2611 (BUG-2014) at 878cf1e7e0 is stacked on #2604, which is now squash-merged to main as 8dd9f48807. `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main` reports CONFLICT (content) in AGENTS.md, and the branch still carries the two pre-squash BUG-2011 commits (2b2ade5502, 01c2879874).

Rebase onto origin/main so only the BUG-2014 commits remain (`git rebase --onto origin/main 01c2879874`), resolve AGENTS.md keeping both paragraphs, re-run `make check-ci-fast`, then post FACTORY READY at the new head. A fresh strict reviewer takes it right after that. It needs advisor signoff under ADR-75 (seat grants).
subject: #2611 BUG-2014 needs rebase (stacked on merged #2604; AGENTS.md conflict)
